title: Noise cancellation khamoshi kaise banata hai?
hooks: Noise cancellation khamoshi kaise banata hai?
Do waves takrate hain... aur shor gayab!
Headphone ke andar yeh chip shor maarta hai
hook_why: Direct curiosity question with the core visual metaphor (waves cancelling) visible at frame 0; matches top-performing tech Shorts that open with the subject noun + mechanism demo.
metaphor: Two identical sound waves meeting 180° out of phase and flattening into a flat line — destructive interference.
mechanism: Microphones on headphone listen to outside noise
Processor analyses the wave shape in real time
Chip generates an inverted copy (180° phase shift)
Speaker plays inverted wave with your audio
Outside wave + inverted wave = destructive interference
Result: low-frequency drone cancels, sudden peaks remain

claims.claim: ANC uses external microphones to detect ambient noise
claims.basis: ABP Live article: 'हेडफोन में छोटे-छोटे माइक्रोफोन लगे होते हैं, जो आसपास की आवाज को सुनते हैं'

claims.claim: Processor creates inverted wave (180° phase shift) for destructive interference
claims.basis: ABP Live: 'प्रोसेसर उसकी पहचान करता है और करीब 180 डिग्री इनवर्टेड साउंड वेव तैयार करता है'; Wikipedia: 'emits a sound wave with the same amplitude but with an inverted phase (also known as antiphase)'

claims.claim: ANC most effective on continuous low-frequency sounds (engine, AC, traffic)
claims.basis: ABP Live: 'यह खास तौर पर लगातार और लो-फ्रीक्वेंसी आवाजों पर ज्यादा प्रभावी होता है. जैसे हवाई जहाज के इंजन की आवाज, ट्रैफिक का लगातार शोर, एयर कंडीशनर या मशीनों की आवाज'

claims.claim: Sudden high-frequency sounds (shouting, dog bark) are harder to cancel
claims.basis: ABP Live: 'वहीं अचानक होने वाली तेज आवाज, जैसे किसी के चिल्लाने या कुत्ते के भौंकने की आवाज को रोकना ANC के लिए ज्यादा मुश्किल होता है'

claims.claim: Passive noise cancellation uses physical design/materials to block sound
claims.basis: ABP Live: 'Passive Noise Cancellation यानी PNC भी काम करती है. इसमें किसी इलेक्ट्रॉनिक साउंड वेव की जरूरत नहीं होती है. हेडफोन का डिजाइन, ईयर कप और उसमें इस्तेमाल होने वाला मटेरियल बाहरी आवाज को कानों तक पहुंचने से रोकने में मदद करता है'

steps_learned: Microphones outside the headphones listen to ambient sounds like traffic or AC.
A chip/processor analyzes the sound wave shape in real-time.
The speaker produces a 180-degree inverted sound wave.
The original noise wave and the inverted wave meet and cancel each other out (Destructive Interference).
Ear cup foam (Passive Noise Cancellation) acts as a physical barrier for sounds the chip can't process.
missing_steps: The specific names of the scientific phenomena: 'Phase Cancellation' or 'Destructive Interference'.
The explanation that ANC is specifically effective on 'low-frequency' sounds, which is why it struggles with high-pitched sudden noises.
unsourced: 20 se 30 dB tak kam hota hai (The source mentions reduction but does not provide specific decibel numbers).
